name: source-contract-completeness
goal: Derive faithful required inputs, component props, export operations, error uncertainty and model storage contracts without changing components.

evidence: Six reported derivation defects plus stale units show: preserve legacy arrays, expose scoped contracts, validate unresolved inputs, and derive model schema without runtime imports.

Existing source-index states covered reads and cache ownership, not contract semantics. Declare one reusable index method state matrix; strengthen existing validator and CLI render cases. CLI E2Es omit required/default flags and fresh source changes.
